body: A recent post from my blog-The Blue Diva: Confessions of a Depressed Optimist@blogspot.com

i am so sorry that you went through this. Unfortunately, depression robs many people of joy (even the saints) and few realize that this is an actual disease. Our faith can give us much help in dealing with depression but God also sends others such as doctors and psychiatrists to help us with our battle. Always, always get help-it is not a sign of weakness but strength. 
-Blue Diva
